brand.slogan: Your company's attendance, requests and expense reports, in the cloud.

home.titolo: Your employees' attendance, without paper sheets or chasing people
home.sottotitolo: Clockings, holidays, leave, overtime and expense reports in a single app: employees request, managers approve, and at month end the timesheet is ready for payroll.

timbratura.title: Clock in from anywhere
timbratura.text: Clock in and out from your smartphone or computer; corrections go through a request.

richieste.title: Requests and approvals
richieste.text: Holidays, leave and absence justifications reach the department manager, who approves or rejects them with one click.

cartellino.title: Always up-to-date timesheet
cartellino.text: Hours worked, absences and overtime calculated every day according to each person's work schedule profile.

noteSpese.title: Expense reports
noteSpese.text: Reimbursements with receipts and invoices attached, approved together with the report.

home.passiTitolo: Up and running in three steps

registra.title: Register your company
registra.text: Attendance management is active straight away, with pay codes and parameters ready to use.

organizza.title: Organise
organizza.text: Sites, departments, schedules and approvers: every request reaches the right person.

chiudi.title: Close the month
chiudi.text: Timesheet reconciliation and approval, then the pay code export for payroll.

home.chiusuraTesto: Register your company and try attendance management with your employees.

features.sottotitolo: Everything you need to manage attendance and absences, from clocking in to the payroll export.

vocale.title: Voice commands and chat
vocale.text: Speak or write to the assistant: clock in, request an absence justification or open the page you need, without looking for it in the menu.

timbrature.title: Clockings
timbrature.text: Clock in and out, and request corrections for forgotten or wrong clockings.

giustificativi.title: Absence justifications
giustificativi.text: Holidays, leave, sickness and the other reason codes, requested by the employee and approved by the manager.

straordinari.title: Overtime and hour bank
straordinari.text: Overtime authorised with an absence justification, and extra hours credited to the hour bank in approved timesheets.

reparti.title: Departments and approvers
reparti.text: For each department, who administers and who approves requests, with the approval mode chosen by the company.

calendario.title: Calendar and holiday plan
calendario.text: Each employee's calendar, the HR calendar and the holiday plan for the whole company.

presenti.title: Staff present
presenti.text: Who is at work, who is absent and why, in real time.

profili.title: Work schedule profiles
profili.text: Schedules, public holidays and sites: the timesheet is calculated on each person's rules.

quadratura.title: Monthly reconciliation
quadratura.text: Check of the month's timesheets, anomalies highlighted and bulk approval.

export.title: Payroll export
export.text: Pay code export with configurable templates, ready for your payroll software.

noteSpese.title: Expense reports
noteSpese.text: Reimbursements with multiple expenses and attachments; approving the report approves all its expenses.

commesse.title: Job orders and activities
commesse.text: Customers, job orders and activities to know what is being worked on, with statistics.

menu.title: Tailored menu
menu.text: The administrator chooses which pages administrators and employees can see.

pricing.sottotitolo: You pay for the employees you manage: all features are always included.

prova.descrizione: To try it with your employees.

studio.descrizione: For labour consultants and payroll firms.

caratteristiche.accessoPerCliente: Access on behalf of the client

pricing.nota: Prices exclude VAT. No commitment: cancel whenever you like.

installare.domanda: Do employees need to install anything?
installare.risposta: No: they clock in and make requests from the browser on their smartphone or computer.

paghe.domanda: Can I use it with my payroll software?
paghe.risposta: Yes: the pay code export is configured with templates suited to the payroll software you use.

approvazione.risposta: The approvers of the employee's department; the administrator can approve for everyone.

consulente.domanda: I am a labour consultant: can I manage several companies?
consulente.risposta: Yes, with the Practice plan you manage your client companies and log in on their behalf when needed.

about.sottotitolo: For years we have worked alongside labour consultants, HR offices and companies.
about.paragrafo1: We know first-hand the work of those who close attendance at month end: sheets to double-check, requests by email, pay codes to copy into the payroll software.
about.paragrafo2: {{siteName}} was created to remove this work: employees request, managers approve and the data reaches payroll already checked.

semplice.title: Simple for employees
semplice.text: Clocking in and requesting leave takes just a few seconds.

preciso.title: Accurate for the HR office
preciso.text: Schedule rules, pay codes and approvals always tracked.

vicino.title: Close to consultants
vicino.text: Exports and templates designed with those who process payroll.

register.sottotitolo: Create your company's account: attendance management is active straight away, with pay codes and parameters ready.
register.condizioni: I accept the terms of service and the privacy policy
register.inviata: We have sent you an email with the link to activate your account: open it and attendance management will be ready straight away.
register.esito: Your company is ready with attendance management active. These are the users created: log in with the password you chose.
